filtered_prose:
Language requirements

Nagoya University offers flexible language options for international students, with programs available in both English and Japanese depending on your academic goals.

English language requirements

G30 International Programs (taught entirely in English)

For undergraduate and graduate degree programs taught entirely in English:

English proficiency test is required
 for most applicants

Exemption is available
 for students who completed four or more consecutive years of secondary education where English was the primary language of instruction

Accepted tests include:

TOEFL

IELTS

Duolingo English Test

No Japanese proficiency is required
 for admission to these programs

Learn more about G30 International Programs

Japanese language requirements

Regular Japanese-taught programs

For students who want to take regular university courses taught in Japanese:

JLPT N1 level required
 (Japanese Language Proficiency Test level 1)

Alternative equivalent qualifications may be accepted

Specialized programs

Intensive Programme in Advanced Japanese:

JLPT N2 level minimum
 required for enrollment

NUPACE exchange students:

Students with 
JLPT N1
 may register for regular Japanese-taught courses

Core NUPACE curriculum taught primarily in English

Program flexibility

Nagoya University provides multiple pathways for international students:

Full degree programs
 available entirely in English through G30 International Programs

Exchange opportunities
 with minimal language barriers through NUPACE

Japanese language support
 through comprehensive language programs

Mixed approach
 allowing qualified students to combine English and Japanese-taught courses

Additional resources

Nagoya University International Programs

Nagoya University main admissions page

Japanese Language Proficiency Test (JLPT) information

For the most current requirements and specific program details, please check the 
admissions program pages
 or contact the university directly.
